narrative: 边缘在拖尾。色相与房间脱钩。
一张脸留下一道污痕。焦点和速度都不肯安分。
场景也许只是一间公寓。但这幅画面呈现的是一套神经系统。
当感知本身就是情节时使用它：毒品、眩晕、濒死、顿悟。挑选几个物理层面的“标志性特征”，反复使用，让这种状态拥有自己的规则。
一道拖影加一次色彩脱钩，就是一种语言。如果什么都同时出现，那就只是噪音。
当只是一个单一、干净的光学效果（一个鱼眼，一次光晕）、角色依然能认出这就是那个房间时，这个手法就用错了。如果编码本身崩溃了，那是数据融化（Datamosh）。
如果两个时间以密度的方式叠加，那是双重曝光（Double Exposure）。意识异变（Altered State）可以借用这些手法，但它必须以“正在看见”的方式获得动机。
how: 组合一份简短的清单：长快门造成的拖影、抽帧印片式的时间处理、错误的白平衡、残像、一片分焦镜（Split Diopter）或畸变光学效果，以及偶尔的叠加。让主体的身体保持足够可辨，以维持在场景之中。
提示词：perception bent, edges trailing, color unhooked from the room, as if consciousness is slipping, not a random glitch pack.
when: 用在一个封闭的室内，画面随角色的意识滑落而扭曲，边缘拖尾，色相出错，时间变得黏稠。不要把它用在一个仍需交代地理位置的建置远景上。
vs: 梦核（Dreamcore）是一种带有阈限空间和走样的童年布光的类型化风格。意识异变（Altered State）则是一种感知事件，常常发生在一个平凡的场景里。
数据融化是编码的崩溃。双重曝光是叠加的记录。
镜头畸变（Distortions）是玻璃造成的几何谎言。意识异变则可能包含畸变，再加上不肯安分的时间和色彩。
examples_film: 《入侵脑细胞》（Enter the Void）把摄影机、拖影和色彩都绑定在一个无法安住于身体中的意识上。《梦之安魂曲》（Requiem for a Dream）用速度、贴近的光学效果和剪辑来表现兴奋和崩溃。
《不羁夜：赌城风情画》（Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas）是那种广角、色彩错乱的表亲。
mistakes: 错误的近亲：单一的鱼眼效果、一次数据融化，或者一间没有任何感知事件的梦核卧室。破绽是：一个干净的房间只贴了一个贴纸式的特效，或者彻底不可辨认。
解决办法是：让两三个反复出现的“标志性特征”获得动机，保持主体可被定位，让房间仍然是一个正在失效的房间。

faq.q: 电影中的“意识异变”是什么？
faq.a: 这是一种主观化的摄影方式，其中拖影、残像、色彩和时间呈现的是一个心灵，而不是一个清醒的房间。它是一整套经过设计的组合，而不是一个孤立的光学效果。

faq.q: 意识异变 vs 镜头畸变
faq.a: 镜头畸变是来自玻璃或空气的几何变形。意识异变可能会用到这些，再加上色彩和时间上的错误，以表现意识。畸变本身可以是清醒的（比如一个窥视孔）。意识异变则不是。

faq.q: 什么时候该用意识异变？
faq.a: 当心灵本身就是场景所在时使用。不要把它当作装饰，用在一场地理上依然需要保持清晰的覆盖镜头上。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写意识异变的提示词？
faq.a: 点明两三个“标志性特征”（拖影、残像、错误的色相、黏稠的时间），并说明意识正在滑落。禁止使用通用的故障叠加效果，并保持主体可辨。

narrative: Edges trail. Hue unhooks from the room.
A face leaves a stain. Focus and speed refuse to sit still.
The set may be an apartment. The picture is a nervous system.
Use it when perception is the plot: drugs, vertigo, dying, revelation. Pick a few physical tells and repeat them so the state has rules.
A smear plus a color unhook is a language. Everything at once is noise.
It is the wrong tool for a single clean optic (one fisheye, one flare) that the character would still recognize as the room. If the codec collapses, that is datamosh.
If two times overlay as density, that is double exposure. Altered state may borrow those, but it has to be motivated as seeing.
how: Combine a short list: long shutter smear, step-printed time, wrong white balance, afterimages, a diopter or a distorting optic, occasional overlay. Keep the body of the subject readable enough to stay in the scene.
Prompt: perception bent, edges trailing, color unhooked from the room, as if consciousness is slipping, not a random glitch pack.
when: A close interior where the frame warps as a character slips, trailing edges, hue wrong, time sticky. Do not apply it to a wide establishing shot that still has to map the street.
vs: Dreamcore is a genre look of liminal rooms and childhood lighting gone wrong. Altered state is the perceptual event, often in an ordinary set.
Datamosh is codec collapse. Double Exposure is a stacked record.
Distortions are geometric lies in the glass. Altered state may include distortion, plus time and color that will not sit.
examples_film: Enter the Void binds camera, smear, and color to a consciousness that will not stay in a body. Requiem for a Dream uses speed, close optics, and cutting as intoxication and crash.
Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas is the wide-angle, wrong-color cousin.
mistakes: Wrong cousin: a single fisheye, a datamosh, or a dreamcore bedroom with no perceptual event. Tell: a clean room with one sticker effect, or total illegibility.
Fix: motivate two or three repeating tells, keep the subject locatable, let the room remain a room that is failing.

faq.q: What is altered state in film?
faq.a: Subjective photography in which smear, afterimage, color, and time report a mind rather than a sober room. It is a motivated bundle, not one optic.
Distortions are geometric warps from glass or air. Altered state may use those, plus color and time errors, as consciousness. Distortion can be sober (a peephole). Altered state is not.

faq.q: When should I use altered state?
faq.a: When the mind is the location. Do not use it as decoration on coverage that still has to be geographically clear.

faq.q: How do I prompt altered state for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name two or three tells (trail, afterimage, wrong hue, sticky time) and say consciousness is slipping. Forbid a generic glitch overlay and keep the subject readable.
